newsitem.title: USA: Brent crude mixed in late U.S. paper trading.
newsitem.headline: Brent crude mixed in late U.S. paper trading.

text.p: The price of North Sea Brent crude oil was mixed in late U.S. paper trading on Tuesday, traders said.
June Brent partial cargoes traded at $17.95, $17.98 and $18.00 a barrel.
The June contract on London's International Petroleum Exchange (IPE) clsoed at $17.99 a barrel.
July Brent partials changed hands twice at $18.13, up two cents from the IPE settlement.
June/July Brent traded twice at minus 12 cents a barrel, down from a range of minus 10 to minus seven cents earlier in the day.
